introduction: According to Draken Film - Göteborg Film FestivalIn the attic of the family's new house, deaf Hilma finds a tape recorder and begins to record her surroundings. In a world that communicates with sound, the tape player becomes her attempt to make herself understood. The sound shifts between Hilma and the hearing surroundings in this innovative portrayal of a young girl's search for community.Director Hanna Sköld has explored alienation and hindered relationships through her directorship, most recently in the acclaimed festival favorite Granny's Dancing on the Table (2015).
